sources.entry: uPic - macOS native app, powerful terse image hosting client. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/gee1k/uPic)

summary.one_liner: uPic is a macOS app that uploads pictures and files to image hosting services and copies the resulting link to the clipboard.
summary.what_it_does: uPic is a native macOS image and file hosting client. It can automatically upload local files and screenshots, and the menu bar shows upload progress. When an upload finishes, the file's link is copied to the clipboard in a format the user chooses: plain URL, HTML, or Markdown. The README lists supported hosts including SM.MS, UPYUN USS, Qiniu KODO, Aliyun OSS, Tencent Cloud COS, Baidu Cloud BOS, Weibo, GitHub, Gitee, Amazon S3, Imgur, and custom upload APIs. Upload methods include file selection from Finder, clipboard files, screenshot capture, drag-and-drop onto the status bar, browser image drag, the macOS Share Extension, and a command-line interface. Global shortcut keys and upload history are also mentioned.
use_cases: upload screenshots to an image host for blog posts
get Markdown or HTML image links for chat or writing
batch upload local files to cloud object storage
share images to Imgur, GitHub, or S3 from the Mac
upload files from the command line on macOS
how_to_run: Install from the Mac App Store (latest version)
Download the app from GitHub or Gitee releases
Grant Full Disk Access in Preferences > Advanced
notable: Automatically copies the upload link to the clipboard as URL, HTML, or Markdown
Supports many image hosts including S3, Imgur, GitHub, Gitee, and custom upload APIs
Menu bar shows ongoing upload progress
Command-line upload and macOS Share Extension support
caveats: Only the App Store build receives the latest version; other installs stay at v0.21.1 per the README
Requires macOS Full Disk Access permission for the app to work
